verify effectiveness of actions Develop and control PFMEA, Control Plans and relevant process-quality documentation; apply SPC, MSA and process capability techniques where relevant Support APQP/PPAP or equivalent customer/product approval requirements where applicable, and ensure quality readiness for new products, changes and launches Lead internal quality audits and process audits; prepare audit plans, follow findings to closure and report significant risks and recurring issues to management Coordinate external certification, surveillance and customer audits; address findings and protect continuity of required certifications Manage customer-quality requirements, complaints, technical quality communication and agreed urgent quality actions; ensure confidentiality of customer and company information Oversee supplier-quality performance and incoming material quality; participate in supplier evaluation, escalation and corrective-action follow-up when quality issues arise Ensure calibration and verification systems for measuring and testing equipment are established, maintained and traceable Ensure identification, traceability, segregation and control of nonconforming product and appropriate storage/handling quality requirements Monitor quality KPIs and trends, analyze performance data, identify systemic risks and lead continuous-improvement initiatives based on evidence Prepare and support Management Review meetings and follow up resulting decisions, actions and improvement commitments Lead, coach and develop the Quality team; define responsibilities, competency requirements, training needs and performance expectations Provide technical quality guidance to Production and other departments while maintaining independent quality judgment and evidence-based decision making During the current organization-building stage, oversee or coordinate applicable environmental, occupational health & safety and related compliance requirements, with clear interfaces and escalation to management Keep applicable quality, environmental and compliance requirements current and support the factory in meeting customer, regulatory and certification obligations KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Customer complaints / customer PPM and closure effectiveness Internal defect and rejection rate First-pass yield / right-first-time performance Scrap and rework attributable to quality issues Corrective-action closure on time and recurrence rate Internal/external audit findings and closure performance Supplier quality / incoming rejection performance Calibration compliance Quality-system implementation and documentation compliance Quality improvement projects delivered and verified impact Training/competency completion for Quality team and relevant operators Requirements HIRING BENCHMARK / CANDIDATE PROFILE Area Benchmark Education Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Production, Industrial or related Engineering discipline. Quality Systems Strong practical knowledge of ISO 9001. IATF 16949 knowledge/experience is strongly preferred where automotive customer requirements apply. Core Quality Tools Practical capability in PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone/root-cause analysis; APQP and PPAP strongly preferred where applicable. Wire Harness Standard Knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620 or equivalent customer-specific wire-harness workmanship/acceptance standards is a major advantage. Technical Capability Hands-on understanding of process quality, inspection, testing, defect analysis, traceability, calibration and manufacturing process controls. Leadership Profile Strong shop-floor presence; able to build systems and teams from an early-stage environment; firm, evidence-based and collaborative; able to challenge Production or other stakeholders professionally without unnecessary conflict. Systems & Data Comfortable using ERP/QMS data, quality dashboards, trend analysis and structured reporting to support decisions. Language Good professional English for standards, customer requirements, audits and technical documentation ROLE STAGE NOTE This role is intentionally broader during the current organization-building stage.
